description: Isabelle From joins Q-Leap as Training Sales Manager to strengthen its software quality training offer in Luxembourg and raise its profile.
seoTitle: Training as a means of guaranteeing software quality - Q-Leap
body:
A few months ago, Isabelle From joined the q-leap team as Training Sales Manager and Account Manager. His main task will be to strengthen the company’s training department, which has acquired expertise in software quality.

Over the past few years, q-leap has built up a solid portfolio of training courses that reflect the issues involved in software quality in development projects. Today, the consulting firm plans to raise the profile of this unique service in Luxembourg. To this end, q-leap has recruited Isabelle From, who has been their Training Sales Manager and Account Manager since last spring. ” As well as being in contact with customers, I’m also responsible for running the company’s new training department. We have developed an offer directly linked to q-leap’s unique expertise in software quality,” she explains. All our services – testing, business analysis, project management, architecture, training – have similar objectives: to disseminate best practices and improve the quality of software development in Luxembourg. “

CERTIFIED TESTING TRAINING

The company has acquired unique expertise through its testing activities. q-leap’s training department is a partner of the International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB), an industry benchmark. We offer all the classes proposed by the ISTQB,” explains Isabelle From. These are certified training courses on the various testing functions.” Alongside the fundamentals, which are explored in a three-day course available in French and English, other more advanced training sessions focus on test automation or security-related testing. The specific training dedicated to testing in the context of agile development is also a great success. “It is therefore possible to acquire basic skills, but also to deepen one’s knowledge of specific issues. With the ISTQB, we give testers the opportunity to evolve, to explore new areas in order to guarantee higher quality developments”, she says. q-leap is also qualified to organize online exams directly from its offices, in collaboration with the GASQ certification body.

QUALITY TRAINING BEYOND TESTING

The q-leap training portfolio also includes business analysis, project management and user experience engineering for a better user experience. Improving the quality of software products is a key objective for business leaders,” explains Isabelle From. Development project teams are strengthened, integrating new key skills. We regularly welcome developers who want to adopt new practices, or project managers who want to reorient their teams towards testing. All of Luxembourg benefits. More and more teams are integrating quality issues.

Discover all the training courses offered by q-leap on its website.

Q-LEAP EXPANDS ITS POOL OF TRAINERS

Faced with growing demand, Q-Leap calls on recognized trainers in Luxembourg. The company has recently begun integrating team members into the training department. ” One of our senior test managers has become a certified trainer to share his expertise. For us, it is extremely important to bring in trainers who know the market well and can offer greater flexibility to Luxembourg players. “adds Isabelle From.

With its growing range of training courses, q-leap is further strengthening its position as the reference leader in software quality testing. ” Companies often put their trust in us because they know we have real expertise in software testing and quality. Our success rate is very satisfactory. And because we’re a small organization, we always take our participants’ expectations into account. “
